req.title: Task update rejects id changes
req.statement: The system shall ignore any id field in the PUT body and only mutate the task addressed by the URL.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-038 requires that when a PUT /tasks/{id} request includes an 'id' field in the body, the system ignores it and mutates only the task addressed by the URL path parameter. Tests must verify: (1) positive — a PUT with a mismatched id in the body still succeeds and the task at the URL id is updated, not a different task; (2) negative — the response id always equals the URL path id, never the body id; (3) boundary — sending id=0 or a very large id in the body does not corrupt the addressed task. The TaskUpdate schema has no 'id' field, so FastAPI/Pydantic will silently strip it; the crud.update_task loop only iterates over fields present in TaskUpdate. Tests assert exact HTTP status codes, exact response field values, and verify the original task's identity is preserved.

tests.name: test_put_body_id_ignored_task_updated_at_url_id
preconditions: A task is created via POST /tasks/ to obtain a known id
actions: POST /tasks/ to create a task and capture its id (url_id)
PUT /tasks/{url_id} with JSON body containing 'id' set to url_id+99 and a new title
Assert response status is 200
Assert response body 'id' equals url_id, not url_id+99
Assert response body 'title' equals the new title sent in the body
trace: R-TASK-038: system shall ignore id field in PUT body
R-TASK-038: only mutate the task addressed by the URL
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_put_body_id_ignored_task_updated_at_url_id():
    client = TestClient(app)
    create_resp = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "original", "completed": False})
    assert create_resp.status_code == 201
    url_id = create_resp.json()["id"]
    fake_id = url_id + 99
    put_resp = client.put(
        f"/tasks/{url_id}",
        json={"id": fake_id, "title": "updated title"}
    )
    assert put_resp.status_code == 200
    body = put_resp.json()
    assert body["id"] == url_id
    assert body["id"] != fake_id
    assert body["title"] == "updated title"

test_put_body_id_ignored_task_updated_at_url_id()

tests.name: test_put_body_id_does_not_corrupt_other_task
preconditions: Two tasks are created to obtain two distinct ids
actions: POST /tasks/ twice to create task_a and task_b
PUT /tasks/{task_a_id} with body containing 'id' set to task_b_id and a new title
Assert response status is 200
Assert response 'id' equals task_a_id
GET /tasks/{task_b_id} and assert task_b title is unchanged
trace: R-TASK-038: system shall only mutate the task addressed by the URL
R-TASK-038: body id field must not redirect mutation to another task
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_put_body_id_does_not_corrupt_other_task():
    client = TestClient(app)
    resp_a = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "task_a_title", "completed": False})
    assert resp_a.status_code == 201
    task_a_id = resp_a.json()["id"]
    resp_b = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "task_b_title", "completed": False})
    assert resp_b.status_code == 201
    task_b_id = resp_b.json()["id"]
    put_resp = client.put(
        f"/tasks/{task_a_id}",
        json={"id": task_b_id, "title": "hijacked title"}
    )
    assert put_resp.status_code == 200
    assert put_resp.json()["id"] == task_a_id
    get_b = client.get(f"/tasks/{task_b_id}")
    assert get_b.status_code == 200
    assert get_b.json()["title"] == "task_b_title"
    assert get_b.json()["id"] == task_b_id

test_put_body_id_does_not_corrupt_other_task()

tests.name: test_put_nonexistent_url_id_returns_404_regardless_of_body_id
actions: PUT /tasks/99999 with body containing 'id' set to 1 and a title
Assert response status is 404
Assert response detail contains '99999'
expected: Error detail references the URL id 99999, not the body id
trace: R-TASK-038: system addresses task by URL id; if not found, 404
NEG: body id cannot substitute for a missing URL-addressed task
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_put_nonexistent_url_id_returns_404_regardless_of_body_id():
    client = TestClient(app)
    put_resp = client.put(
        "/tasks/99999",
        json={"id": 1, "title": "should not matter"}
    )
    assert put_resp.status_code == 404
    detail = put_resp.json()["detail"]
    assert "99999" in detail

test_put_nonexistent_url_id_returns_404_regardless_of_body_id()

tests.name: test_put_body_id_same_as_url_id_succeeds_and_returns_correct_id
preconditions: A task is created to obtain a valid id
actions: POST /tasks/ to create a task with known url_id
PUT /tasks/{url_id} with body containing 'id' equal to url_id (same value) and a new title
Assert response status is 200
Assert response 'id' equals url_id
Assert response 'title' equals the new title
Assert response 'completed' equals False (unchanged)
trace: R-TASK-038: even when body id matches URL id, system uses URL id
DT: decision table row where body_id == url_id (no conflict)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_put_body_id_same_as_url_id_succeeds_and_returns_correct_id():
    client = TestClient(app)
    create_resp = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "same id task", "completed": False})
    assert create_resp.status_code == 201
    url_id = create_resp.json()["id"]
    put_resp = client.put(
        f"/tasks/{url_id}",
        json={"id": url_id, "title": "same id updated", "completed": False}
    )
    assert put_resp.status_code == 200
    body = put_resp.json()
    assert body["id"] == url_id
    assert body["title"] == "same id updated"
    assert body["completed"] == False

test_put_body_id_same_as_url_id_succeeds_and_returns_correct_id()
